extName.description: The extension's name in the store and the browser.

extDescription.message: Links your Notula notes to the video or lesson you’re watching. Works with the Notula app on this computer.
extDescription.description: Store short description, at most 132 characters.

commandMark.message: Mark this moment in your Notula note
commandMark.description: The keyboard command's description on the browser's shortcuts page.

disclosureBody.message: On YouTube and on sites you turn on, it reads the playing video’s address, title and current time, and sends them only to the Notula app on this computer. Nothing goes to any server.

disclosureDetail.message: With a note open, Notula can also get the video captions the player has loaded and the course, section and lesson shown on the page. Private windows are left out unless you allow them.

disclosureAccepted.message: The extension is on. You can change what it reads below.
disclosureAccepted.description: Shown after the explanation was accepted.

connSetup.message: Read what this extension sends first.
connSetup.description: Popup status before the first-run explanation is accepted.

connIdle.message: Ready. Connects to Notula when a video plays.

connConnectedVersion.description: Popup status with the app version.

connOffInNotula.message: Notula isn’t reading playback. Turn on Sources in Notula ▸ Settings ▸ Labs.
connOffInNotula.description: Popup status when Notula answers mode none.

connHostMissing.message: Turn on the browser extension in Notula ▸ Settings ▸ Sources.
connHostMissing.description: Popup status: the native host isn't registered.

connHostForbidden.message: Notula doesn’t recognize this copy of the extension. Use Repair in Notula ▸ Settings ▸ Sources.
connHostForbidden.description: Popup status: the extension id isn't allowed.

connHostFailed.message: Can’t start Notula’s helper. Use Repair in Notula ▸ Settings ▸ Sources.
connHostFailed.description: Popup status: the native host failed.

connAppOutdated.message: Update Notula to use this extension.

connExtensionOutdated.message: This extension is out of date. Your browser updates it on its own.

siteOn.description: Popup, current tab on a site the user turned on.

siteLinked.message: Reading this tab until it leaves this site.

siteUnsupported.description: Popup, a browser page or a non-https page.

enableSite.description: Button; asks the browser for access to the site.

linkTab.description: Button; reads this tab once, without site access.

incognitoPaused.message: Paused in private windows. Turn them on in Settings to read here.

captionsHint.message: Turn on captions in the player once to load them.
captionsHint.description: Popup hint when captions need the player's token.

transcriptHeld.message: Read $COUNT$ transcript lines. Notula gets them when this lesson’s note is open.

transcriptFailed.message: Couldn’t read the transcript. Try again.

markHeld.message: Marked $POSITION$. Take notes in Notula to keep it.
markHeld.description: Result: no note yet, Notula holds the mark.

markNoMedia.message: Nothing is playing in a tab Notula can read.

shortcutNone.description: Shown when the command has no key.

sitesHint.message: To read another site, open it and choose Enable on this site in the extension’s menu.

turnOffSite.description: Accessible label of the button next to a site.

captionsDesc.message: Sends the captions a player has loaded, and transcripts you ask for, so Notula can use them as the transcript.

incognitoDesc.message: Also allow the extension in private windows in your browser’s extension details, and turn on private windows in Notula ▸ Settings ▸ Sources.

incognitoBrowserOff.message: Your browser doesn’t let the extension run in private windows yet.

changeShortcut.description: Button; opens the browser's shortcuts page.

shortcutHint.message: Works while the browser is in front. Notula has its own shortcut for other apps.

notulaBody.message: The extension needs the Notula app on this computer, with the browser extension turned on in Settings ▸ Sources.

privacyBody.message: The extension sends what it reads only to Notula on this computer. It has no server and makes no requests of its own, except one caption request to YouTube when Notula asks for captions.
